# T1 — field-projection engine + allowlist (bounded engineer task)

Repo: /home/opencode/projects/default/mcp-bridge (Go). Read the approved spec first: `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket05-spec-r21.md` (revision r21, APPROVED). Focus on sections 1-2 (R1-R7), 4 (C1-C3, D-table rows 1-21, ladder L1-L6), 5 (AC1, AC3, AC5, AC6), 6 (T1), and 10.

## Ownership
You own ONLY these two files:
- CREATE `internal/service/field_projection.go`
- CREATE `internal/service/field_projection_test.go`
Do NOT modify any other file. Do NOT touch delivery, tools.go, direct_execution.go, catalog/schema.go, result_handle.go, observe/*, README, docs. T2 will wire the engine into the invocation paths; T3 adds observability.

## Concrete contract (follow the spec exactly)
Define in `internal/service/field_projection.go`:
- `type projectionEntry struct { Server, Tool, Path string; DefaultFields []string }`
- `var projectionAllowlist = []projectionEntry{ {Server:"portainer", Tool:"EndpointList", DefaultFields: []string{"Id","Name","Type"}}, {Server:"portainer", Tool:"docker_proxy", Path:"/containers/json", DefaultFields: []string{"Id","Name","State","Image"}} }`
- `type projectionDecision struct { Applied bool; Entry string; Mode string; Fields []string; Reason string }`
- A pure decision function `decideProjection(server, tool, path string, args map[string]any, itemCount int) (projectionDecision, error)` implementing: exact-identity allowlist match (R1), default projection when no explicit request (R2), `fields` mode with raw-key validation (R4), `full:true` opt-in (R3), the TOTAL pre-dispatch ladder L1-L6 with first-match-wins single reason (R4/CR-R15-1), and the closed 12-value reason enum (8 skip + 4 reject) from the spec.
- A projection transformer that takes decoded upstream list items ([]any of map[string]any) and returns the projected list plus the decision: containers map to `Id`, `Name` from `Names[0]` (omit `Name` when Names is missing/empty), `State`, `Image`; endpoints map to `Id`, `Name`, `Type`; field selection returns exactly the requested raw keys; empty list + default applies; empty list + fields is accepted; non-empty list with an unknown field rejects.
- `fields` in every decision follows the spec's SINGLE mode-aware rule: requested list on fields-mode rows, the entry default list on default-mode rows (apply/skip/override), [] only on full-mode and no-match rows; `Entry` is the allowlist entry id and "" when no entry matched; `Mode` is the producing mode including skip rows.
- `full:false` with a present `fields` member is a FIELDS request (applies); only `full:true` + present `fields` is L2 malformed_request; `fields` + present `select` is L3 select_conflict (after L1/L2).
- Bounds at L4: present-but-empty fields, duplicates, >16 entries, any entry >64 chars, non-[A-Za-z0-9_] characters => malformed_request. Static validation precedes operation support and the runtime budget.

## Tests (RED first)
In `internal/service/field_projection_test.go`, write deterministic table-driven tests BEFORE the implementation, watch them fail, then implement:
- AC1/AC5: endpoint default projection returns EXACTLY Id/Name/Type; container default returns Id/Name/State/Image with Names-missing/empty behavior; allowlist negative neighbors (`portainer__EndpointLists`, `other__EndpointList`, docker_proxy with another path) do not match.
- AC3: fields selection, unknown-field rejection, empty-list+fields acceptance, fields:[] rejection, full+fields rejection (full:true only), select+fields rejection, false-valued composites `{full:false, fields:["Id"]}` applies and `{full:false, fields:["Id"], select:"x"}` => select_conflict.
- AC6: non-object item and non-empty all-defaults-missing degrade to skip with the spec's reason values, never silent field dropping.
- Ladder: composite inputs yield exactly one declared reason; no two-outcome input.

Test package: `package service` (internal, same package). Use only stdlib + existing test deps. No live infrastructure, no network.

## Verify
Run: `go test ./internal/service -run 'TestFieldProjection' -count=1` (must pass) and `gofmt -l internal/service/field_projection.go internal/service/field_projection_test.go` (empty output). Report RED and GREEN command output. Do not run the whole suite.
